River Gate roadside elms · Wildfire Games
Copyright (C) Wildfire Games and 0 A.D. contributors.
The two meshes in road_elms.glb and the diffuse cutout elm.png are adapted from tree_elm_01.dae, tree_elm_02.dae and tree_elm_01.png in the upstream 0 A.D. public art collection. Luanshi contributors fitted the original fork to two pre-existing army-field placements, reduced the three diffuse value bands, and fitted foliage normals and wind weights. Both original and adapted artwork are Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.
